$comment: Contract for data/tables/class_limits.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js; compiled and applied by build/src/evidence-ledger.js (D154).
title: Class limits
description: Physics limits per kind of plastic (D154): a stiffness no unfilled rubber reaches, the density range of an unfilled polymer. The evidence ledger reads each as a bound on the headline for a product of the kind with no comparable value of its own, never for a declared variant or a material of undisclosed commercial variants. A limit decides only beyond the wider of its sourced value and the kind's own published extreme among its products that are not variants, and the engine's test scatter is added to that. A plausibility window (plausibility_windows.csv) is a check on what a sheet prints, never a filter (D141); a limit may name the window it agrees with in its Basis. A limit lands reported, and needs a registered, cited source before it is switched to deciding.

fields.name: Target headline
fields.description: The selectable measurement headline the limit bounds (headline_definitions.csv).

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: ceiling: the headline is at most Value; floor: at least Value; neat-density range: within the neat range polymers.csv records for the material's polymer, read only from a polymer row with a recorded SourceID.

fields.name: Value
fields.description: The limit, in the headline's unit. Not applicable for a neat-density range, which polymers.csv holds.

fields.name: Applies to
fields.description: The kind of plastic, in the registry's Applies-to grammar ("Morphology: elastomer; Modifier / filler: Unfilled / unspecified"). A product with a Variant, and a material whose Modifier / filler is Commercial variant / undisclosed, is never of the kind.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: reported: computed and listed, never a pass, a fail or a changed reason; deciding: decides for a product of the kind with no comparable value of its own. A limit with a Value needs a registered, cited source to decide (CLASS-LIMIT-SOURCE).

fields.name: Reason words
fields.description: The kind as a reason names it, at the head of a sentence: "An unfilled rubber (TPU, PEBA, OBC)".

fields.name: SourceID
fields.description: The registered handbook or producer reference that prints the limit. Not recorded where none is registered yet (the limit then stays reported); Not applicable for a neat-density range, whose polymers.csv rows name their own.

fields.name: Basis
fields.description: The physics, where the number comes from, and the plausibility window it agrees with, if any.
